bio: Francesca Moraca was born at San Mango D'Aquino in Calabria, Italy, the daughter of Domenico Moraca and Domenica Mendicino. She married Bruno Ferlaino there on 3 November 1777. She was the mother of both Nicola Maria Ferlaino, born in 1778, and Vincenzo Ferlaino, born in 1781, and since John descends from both sons she is his 5th-great-grandmother through two lines.
